Static glyphs derived from the public UI primitives of DeepSeek Harness.
Version: 0.1.3-alpha.1
Commit: d347e703908d0406b7a7ef80e3a0e594d86b2215
Source: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/d347e703908d0406b7a7ef80e3a0e594d86b2215/packages/client/ui-primitives/src
Files: icons/index.tsx, ReferenceIcon.tsx, LinkIcon.tsx.

Original geometry is unchanged. JSX attributes were converted to SVG attributes,
internal IDs namespaced, and symbols named for blog actions.
ReferenceIcon(session) and LinkIcon(image) are variants of public exports.

Symbol to upstream component:
  copy: IconCopyOutline16
  like: IconLikeOutline16
  dislike: IconDislikeOutline16
  more: IconEllipsisOutline16
  branch: IconBranchOutline16
  refresh: IconRefreshOutline16
  comment: ReferenceIcon(session)
  paperclip: IconPaperclipOutline16
  send: IconSendOutline16
  stop: IconStopFill16
  menu: IconPanelLeftOutline16
  close: IconCloseOutline16
  new-chat: IconNewChatOutline16
  chat: ReferenceIcon(session)
  article: IconBrowseOutline16
  settings: IconSettingsOutline16
  search: IconSearchOutline16
  chevron-down: IconChevronDownOutline14
  external: IconRightUpOutline16
  image: LinkIcon(image)
  bold: IconEditOutline16
  italic: IconEditOutline16
  heading: IconBrowseOutline16
  code: IconCodeOutline16
  list: IconQueueOutline14
  link: IconLinkOutline16
  save: IconCheckOutline16
  backup: IconArchiveOutline20

Closest available substitutions: menu=panel, list=queue, save=check,
bold/italic=edit, heading=document. Keep visible B/I/H2 labels for formatting.
